name: Send: dock own man
when: from Act II, at the board or in talk with one of his men

steps.verb: dock own man: given at the board or in talk; the named man does it on the next night his routine allows

keys.how: at night, unseen, at the target's door or his road home
in the open, as a message the street can read
at the quietest hour of the target's routine (routines.json)

returns: Frank learns the morning after from the man's own line; the town can trace the chain
src: BLUEPRINT-01 1.7.2 and RT-08 (the eight verbs); an example target, not a script
target: chosen from the Ledger (a person or place Frank knows); never Sheila, Pauline, Ada, June, Alison, Ellis, the Widow, Father Walsh or anyone 60 or over (RT2-05, RT-09): Frank refuses in his own words
man: chosen: one of his men; resolved by the man's nerve against the target's, the watchers, the light and the noise, within two game nights (1.7.2)
